왜냐면 ... 이미 내 글을 많이 읽었다면 예측이 되리라 믿는다. 안된다면 복습. 복습 !! sorry :(

근데 뭘 말하다가 여기까지 왔지?

desc_en:
It's July.
I don't know about last year, but this year July is going to be a really good month for me.
Because... if you've read a lot of my posts, I believe you can already predict this. If not, review. Review !! sorry :(

Lab life during summer vacation starts for real !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

I don't even know how happy this is
Some people look at this and pull every negative word out of the dictionary.. slave this, that, whatever..
Strangely, more than the version of me just lying down, scratching my belly, watching YouTube and laughing,
I like the version of me that gets truly, fiercely absorbed in something, then looks at the time and is shocked

And that moment when my body is so exhausted, but I do one more hour anyway and beat physical fatigue with willpower
I love that so much.. no, by then I already feel so much like myself that it just feels good.

What am I doing in July? That's not a hard question to answer
The share of math and science gets a lot, lot bigger.
The goal for summer vacation is to graduate from the entire high school curriculum,,,

Easy to say. In terms of content it might not even be that hard,
I've already spent years on things like the limit of a function for the CSAT,
so even if I establish the concepts without them feeling that unfamiliar,

I still have to write the concept of the limit of a function from a blank page on a legal pad, then tear off another sheet
and write it down again in various colored pens as if I'm explaining it to someone,
then open an IDE and figure out how to write code for the limit of a function in Python and how to visualize it,
google it, dig through Stack Overflow, do everything, and even push it to GitHub
before it's Limit of a Function: END. Just reading and being done. I will never do that, no matter how short on time I am
I'd rather extend the deadline to the next day and do it properly;;

Science is.. the opposite now.
From the content itself, it arrives feeling unfamiliar.
Sometimes I think wait? I know this? and on one hand I'm glad,
and on the other I stay cautious, because the moment I get swallowed by that thought and pretend to know something I don't actually know,
a bloodbath follows, so I keep thinking I'm a fool among fools, a real fool, as I take in the subject.

Ah, and now that I think about it, besides math and science I also study computer architecture!!
It's a book called Nand to Tetris? the actual title is longer, but that part feels like a proper noun
If someone asks why computer architecture is necessary on the journey toward Deep Learning
and whether I really have to study it, I still... wouldn't be able to clearly say yes!! I must !!

There were exactly two reasons I started studying it.
1. In the end, the thing that runs the code is inside the computer.
2. Jeff Dean :)

At first #2 was a bit stronger, these days #1 is stronger,
and on some days #2 is stronger again, it just... goes back and forth
when Jeff Dean's coffee went cold, Google's search engine got fas....

Anyway. Given my personality, I was clearly going to learn it someday
and I figured there was even less reason to delay it,
and even if I learn it, nobody's going to complain, and learning it has no (-) factor,
so it's summer vacation, I have some time. I decided to learn it.

I don't remember when I wrote this, but
in the end.. LNNet so you gave up!! that's not it computing was so desperate
that I applied to Google TRC.

No matter how I think about it, going on a T4, or sometimes even burning through all the compute units and falling back to CPU
is too hard. Honestly, whether I eat, whether I study, whatever I do,
nothing changes, so it felt so suffocating that I decided to apply to TRC.
TRC.. I'm looking forward to it

Something I've been thinking about lately is paper implementations...
I kind of want to help people with paper implementations
Of course I'm not the one helping, just.. just.. haha, the timing to talk about this will come someday
and if I do talk about it, I think I'll be able to give an overview then

Just various fun thoughts, and every time they come before I sleep, sometimes I spit spit spit and throw the thought away,
and other times the thought is so good I write it in my notebook, fall asleep with a smile, and when I wake up and look at it
there are days where I go wait..?

But it's really amazing.
If it's already July, that means I started this in January
January resolve retrospect February resolve retrospect March resolve retrospect . . . . all the way to July's resolve
In terms of quantity alone it looks like so little, but while I'm writing it, personally it's not an easy task.

For one thing I'm someone who doesn't? can't..?? express myself honestly that well
and I don't even know myself well, so writing well about my own month is.. not easy at all.
The titles, at least, I don't even really think about. Sometimes in the shower,
sometimes while waiting for a drink, something pops into my head and I just keep going with that, and that's how it continued I think

The insides are um... really just rambling
I don't even set a format, it's closer to just writing,
so sometimes when I reread it I wonder why I wrote it like that back then..? haha

Of course.
Research is research, but personally, in the Re Section as well
I put transparency above everything else as priority #1
so if you look carefully on GitHub you can tell I uploaded all of this as markdown
and that I didn't even edit it.

But what was I talking about that brought me here?
Anyway. July is.. a month I was personally looking forward to, and had been waiting for,
so I want to go run.

I can't even gauge how much luck the lucky number 7 of July —
the 1 from January with its head bowed a little more — will bring me,,
but the one feeling I always carry, I want to go with just that.

I need to be more humble, and bow my head more.
I'm still lacking a lot, and I am truly a fool among fools.
So I just want to run more, and run again, and run even more more more.. then drink a little water
and keep going.

Honestly I'm so excited for July.
As I said earlier, the things I have to do are a mountain.
There's so much I have to study, and it's a time to move forward,
there's so much I want to learn, so many plans I've set, and the problem is I only have one body
which is... sometimes a relief, and at the same time a shame.

Did I set a goal for July?
July's goal is simple, and also really hard.
Because.... if someone came up to me right now and asked what's your July goal!!
personally the July goal I'm thinking of right now is... no regrets.
and that's in the realm of the impossible.. of course I've never doubted a day I've run.
But not doubting and still having regrets are clearly different.

At least, wherever I point on the calendar at a day I've run,
I can think, well, even then I was thinking of the best like a greedy algorithm ~.~
and yet... there are really, really many regrets left.

Even yesterday there were probably many regrets, and looking at today tomorrow there will be many regrets too
no regrets... I want to try the challenge at least. But I'm not confident.
A life lived as a local maximum, I might be confident in challenging,
but without regrets..? ah I don't know I don't know just try it, let's try, let's do it.
Please look forward to July's retrospect. I will come back saying I absolutely have no regrets !!! that's a lie.


Leaving "I'll come back someday with a fun thought" feels like it amps up expectations too much
and "I'll come back if a fun thought comes to me someday" is a bit like that too..

Just ! I hope everyone is happy, that seems better
then I think who would even see this !! so maybe I should just end it here !
but on the other hand someone might see it, so writing I hope you're happy! is what am I even saying

Anyway.
I'll close by engraving here the phrase I use most and like the most

May you have been happy, may you be happy, may you stay happy. Always :) and forever.

Bye!
